cards.card_text: This is what happened in the days of King Xerxes, who reigns over 127 provinces from India to Cush from his royal throne in the citadel of Susa.
cards.verse_text: In those days King Xerxes sat on his royal throne in the citadel of Susa.
cards.snippet: In those days King Xerxes sat on his royal throne in the citadel of Susa.

cards.card_text: Everyone in the citadel of Susa Only the princes of the provinces Only the military leaders of Persia
cards.verse_text: At the end of this time, in the garden court of the royal palace, the king held a seven-day feast for all the people in the citadel of Susa, from the least to the greatest.
cards.snippet: …the king held a seven-day feast for all the people in the citadel of Susa, from the least to the greatest.

cards.card_text: His attendants propose a plan: commissioners in every province gather beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa.
cards.verse_text: Then the king’s attendants proposed, “Let a search be made for beautiful young virgins for the king, and let the king appoint commissioners in each province of his kingdom to assemble all the beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa.
cards.snippet: …to assemble all the beautiful young women into the harem at the citadel of Susa.

cards.card_text: Now meet Mordecai son of Jair, a Jewish man from the tribe of Benjamin, living at the citadel of Susa.
cards.verse_text: Now there was at the citadel of Susa a Jewish man from the tribe of Benjamin named Mordecai son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish.
cards.snippet: Now there was at the citadel of Susa a Jewish man from the tribe of Benjamin named Mordecai…

cards.card_text: The couriers head out, spurred on by the king's command, and the edict is issued in the citadel of Susa.
cards.verse_text: The couriers left, spurred on by the king’s command, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa.
cards.snippet: …on by the king’s command, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa.

cards.card_text: The couriers ride out in haste on their royal horses, pressed on by the king's command, and the edict goes out in the citadel of Susa too.
cards.verse_text: And the edict was also issued in the citadel of Susa.
cards.snippet: And the edict was also issued in the citadel of Susa.

cards.card_text: Zion's got citadels, and in my bakery the only thing guarding the ovens is me and a mustache.

cards.verse_text: The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself—the LORD, the God of Hosts, has declared: “I abhor Jacob’s pride and detest his citadels, so I will deliver up the city and everything in it.”
